notes.title: start;again at TasPop Convention!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Gabby here from Two and a Half Studios!

I hope you're all doing well - it's been very busy over here at the studio.

We attended our first convention last weekend, and I thought I'd share some pictures!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yYEY3CQ.jpg[/img]

Here's a look at our booth, which showcased our three completed games and also our new upcoming game, Dreambound!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o7ztWq3.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GYoKnQM.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rQahi4A.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/E3GbUqJ.jpg[/img]

And some of the brand new merch we made just for the event!

We had a great time at TasPop South, and even met some people who had already played our games - something we didn't expect, in our little home town.

Also, we have leftovers of some of our new merch up on [url=https://www.twoandahalfstudios.com/shop]our webstore right now[/url], too! Our store will be open until the 4th of August!
